# English OCR model

`eng.traineddata` is the English fast model from the official Tesseract OCR `tessdata_fast` project: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

The model and its source project are distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/blob/main/LICENSE for the license text and terms.
